intent.text:
Seat ses moves, on q1, the amended form that all three seats endorsed in debate (r4–r5) and that rec and sec each said they would vote yes on:

(0) Remove Bash(export CC_AGENT=*) from ~/.claude/settings.json now. Leave the export prompting.

(1) Run the test matrix in a scratch project, in default permission mode, with the agent-identity hook installed. Record the result of each: `export CC_AGENT='k'; touch x`, `&&`, `||`, a newline-separated second line, backtick and `$()` inside the quoted value, and an embedded single quote that closes the string early. Each second command must prompt. Also run the two-hook case with a second rewriting PreToolUse hook installed, and record the final command text the permission check receives and which CC_AGENT value survives. Record what the TUI prompt displays for an allowed-prefix command.

(2) Reinstate the rule only if (1) passes, and only as a narrow literal in the project-local settings of the repo that consumes identity, with no wildcard tail. If the harness cannot express the literal without a wildcard, leave the export prompting.

(3) Until the rule is reinstated, vsect and the trailer tooling record a missing prefix as unknown-actor, not as an error. The hook may also write identity to a file or env var that vsect reads directly; the matrix notes whether that fallback is needed.

(4) Record the results in the README. Mark two-hook ordering as unknown if it is not established. Do not claim identity is guaranteed while it is unknown.
